reuse.why: Extends the existing assertBankAccountCanBeLinked guard used by all six link functions and extracts the unlink field-clearing from unlinkAccount into clearAccountBankLink, reused by both paths.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; only the two-line assert-then-unlinkReplacedAccounts pair is repeated in each of the six provider link functions.

placement.why: All changes are in accounts/app.ts next to the existing link guard and unlinkAccount.

scope.why: Flag, guard change, shared unlink helper and tests only.

maintainability.why: Clear and consistent, though an 'assert' function that now returns the holders to unlink is a slightly surprising contract and the pair could be one helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link function goes through assertBankAccountCanBeLinked; unlinkAccount now uses clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the unlink field list was moved into a shared helper rather than copied.
